section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining associations between body appreciation and self-enhancement/self-expression variables among college students. The study included 261 students (60.9% female, mean age 20.16 years) from a non-residential college in the northeastern United States who completed a questionnaire measuring body appreciation, interest in cosmetic enhancements, and need for uniqueness. Results indicated that higher body appreciation was associated with greater need for uniqueness and investment in distinctive appearance, particularly among African Americans/Blacks.
